description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. description:
We are conducting a confidential search for a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This pivotal role is ideal for a professional passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards, optimizing operational efficiency, and maintaining high-quality care. This leadership opportunity allows you to make a significant impact on the lives of residents and the success of the organization.

This full-time position offers a competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on your experience and qualifications. Join a team committed to excellence and innovation in healthcare.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities.
Demonstrated ability to manage financial performance, human resources, and quality assurance programs.
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Family Medicine Physician to join a premier community health clinic in Greenville, SC. This is an exceptional opportunity for an MD or DO specializing in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, or Med/Pediatrics to make a significant impact within a supportive environment.

This role offers a highly competitive compensation package, including a non-negotiable base salary of $210,000 per year. In addition, you will receive a guaranteed $25,000 bonus and the potential for an additional $25,000 bonus, totaling up to $50,000 in incentives. A $9,000 sign-on/relocation bonus is available on payday one for eligible candidates. The position also comes with great benefits and generous Paid Time Off (PTO).

While full-time is preferred, we are open to reviewing all physician candidates for part-time, PRN, or contract arrangements, offering flexibility to suit your professional needs. This is a chance to join a team that values your expertise and offers a compensation structure significantly above the state average for Family Medicine MDs in South Carolina.
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification/Eligibility in Family Medicine (preferred), Internal Medicine, or Med/Pediatrics
Active South Carolina medical license (or eligibility for licensure)
Experience in a family medicine or primary care setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: Non-negotiable base salary of $210,000 per year, plus a guaranteed $25,000 bonus and an additional $25,000 potential bonus. A $9,000 sign-on/relocation bonus is available on payday 1 with a promissory note. Compensation is significantly above the state average for Family Medicine MDs in SC.

description:
